'''Hortrix Steelarm''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who worked for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:Gfc" /> Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] working on behalf of [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]] [[Death|killed]] Steelarm while he piloted his [[G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighter]] ''[[Scythe IV]]'' in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]].<ref name="AED" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Hortrix Steelarm appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="AED" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Hortrix Steelarm was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="AED" />
